results.reservation_rules:
Reservation rules
【Notice】
・Please refrain from taking pictures with shutter sound and flash. If you do, try to take in a short time and make sure to keep other customers and staffs out of the picture frame.
・Please don't give your reservation to others.
・Please make sure you give yourself plenty of time to come and note that we can't serve all the dishes if you are late.
・We will cancel your reservation if you are late more than 30 mins and give your seats to other customers.
・Please note that we may not be able to respond to your request even if it is stated in the special notes. We thank you in advance for your understanding.
